response.text: The duplicate pair is confirmed: same vendor, same invoice number once the trailing spaces and leading zeros are normalised, same date and amount, and two separate journals. Invoice 203 was posted at 13131.62 while the header shows 13158.62. Its journal is balanced, so the gap is between the subsidiary record and the ledger, not an unbalanced entry. I'll submit now.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM("CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=1361 GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT"))>0.001
findings.summary: Journal 1361 is unbalanced: DR 18270.61 vs CR 18234.61 (difference 36.00).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM("CR_AMT") AS cr FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=1894 GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT"))>0.001
findings.summary: Journal 1894 is unbalanced: DR 9151.30 vs CR 9124.30 (difference 27.00).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") AS acct FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL
findings.summary: Journal 1835 line 2 references account 5950, which does not exist in GLCOA.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", TRIM(i."VEND_CD") AS vend, i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i."VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g'))='V0015' AND REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i."INV_NO"),'^0+','')='V0015-18723-505'
findings.summary: Vendor V0015 invoice V0015-18723-505 is recorded twice: INV_ID 505 (journal 1846, status P) and INV_ID 801 (journal 2484, status O), same date 20241009 and amount 23367.74. The trailing-space variant of the invoice number is a normalisation artefact.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", l."CR_AMT" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE i."INV_ID"=203 AND c."ACCT_TYP"='LIABILITY'
findings.summary: AP invoice 203 (vendor V0007) has INV_AMT 13158.62 but its journal 1345 credits the liability account 2000 only 13131.62 (27.00 short). The journal balances, so the subsidiary record and the ledger disagree.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journal 2485 has POST_DT 20241022, which falls after period 9 was closed on 20241005 (period 9 runs 20240901-20240930).
AP invoice 802 (vendor V0022) has a negative INV_AMT of -5068.99 (likely a credit memo recorded as an invoice, with no documented sign convention). It is still open (O) and posted to journal 2487.
